idea-plugin.name: Local LLM Desktop Bridge
idea-plugin.description: Talks to the local-llm-desktop HTTP bridge on 127.0.0.1 (enable under Settings in the desktop app). Shows live connection / health in the tool window (GET /health). Includes a Local LLM tool window: prompt the local model, optionally attach a structural knowledge graph built from Java (PSI) and Kotlin (text heuristics, no Kotlin K1 PSI — compatible with Kotlin K2 mode), optional apply file blocks from model replies (with confirmation), a domain vocabulary view (terms grouped by package domain), and follow-up when the model asks for clarification ([CLARIFY] protocol). Configure port and optional bearer token under Settings → Tools → Local LLM Desktop.

action.description: Open Local LLM tool window (prefills from selection when present)
